canonical_encoding: RFC 8785 JSON unless a contract names canonical CBOR
digest: SHA-256 over canonical bytes with the digest field omitted

contracts.name: SourceUnit
contracts.canonical_encoding: RFC 8785 JSON with UTF-8 source bytes encoded as base64url
contracts.unknown_fields: Reject unknown critical fields; preserve namespaced optional annotations.
contracts.privacy: Source can contain party identifiers and private literals; do not transmit by default.

contracts.name: PackageLock
contracts.canonical_encoding: RFC 8785 JSON sorted by package identity
contracts.unknown_fields: Reject unknown fields that affect resolution or signatures.
contracts.privacy: Public build metadata; authenticated registry credentials are excluded.

contracts.name: TypedProgram
contracts.canonical_encoding: Versioned deterministic compiler IR encoding
contracts.unknown_fields: Reject unknown semantic nodes.
contracts.privacy: Retains source visibility labels; private literals remain marked private.

contracts.name: CoreArtifact
contracts.canonical_encoding: Deterministic canonical CBOR defined by the Core serializer version
contracts.unknown_fields: Reject unknown Core tags and critical fields.
contracts.privacy: Core visibility is explicit; secret constants require private packaging and cannot affect undeclared public effects.

contracts.name: SourceMap
contracts.canonical_encoding: RFC 8785 JSON sorted by generated span
contracts.unknown_fields: Ignore only namespaced display hints.
contracts.privacy: Can reveal source structure; redact source text in exported evidence.

contracts.name: Diagnostic
contracts.canonical_encoding: RFC 8785 JSON
contracts.unknown_fields: Ignore namespaced presentation fields; reject unknown severity or phase.
contracts.privacy: Messages use identifiers and bounded excerpts; secret values are redacted.

contracts.name: ResourceCertificate
contracts.canonical_encoding: RFC 8785 JSON
contracts.unknown_fields: Reject unknown fields that can change a bound.
contracts.privacy: Public deployment evidence; excludes witnesses and private state.

contracts.name: CapabilityManifest
contracts.canonical_encoding: RFC 8785 JSON sorted by capability identifier
contracts.unknown_fields: Reject unknown capability kinds.
contracts.privacy: Public trust-boundary declaration.

contracts.name: VisibilityManifest
contracts.canonical_encoding: RFC 8785 JSON sorted by stable value identifier
contracts.unknown_fields: Reject unknown visibility states and declassification rules.
contracts.privacy: Contains labels and digests only; it must not contain private values.

contracts.name: TranslationCertificate
contracts.canonical_encoding: RFC 8785 JSON
contracts.unknown_fields: Reject unknown claim, status, or toolchain fields.
contracts.privacy: Public evidence; trace corpus may use commitments when private test data exists.

contracts.name: BuildReceipt
contracts.canonical_encoding: RFC 8785 JSON
contracts.unknown_fields: Reject unknown status or output roles.
contracts.privacy: Redact user paths, credentials, and environment secrets.

contracts.name: DeploymentManifest
contracts.canonical_encoding: RFC 8785 JSON
contracts.unknown_fields: Reject unknown critical target, constructor, or certificate fields.
contracts.privacy: Public template metadata; concrete private bindings use ConstructorBindings.

contracts.name: SoftwareBillOfMaterials
contracts.canonical_encoding: Canonicalized CycloneDX JSON profile
contracts.unknown_fields: Follow the pinned CycloneDX profile; reject unknown critical extensions.
contracts.privacy: Public release evidence; private registry locations are redacted.

contracts.name: ConstructorBindings
contracts.canonical_encoding: RFC 8785 JSON with canonical ledger encodings
contracts.unknown_fields: Reject unknown binding roles.
contracts.privacy: Public bindings are explicit; private constructor material uses committed or encrypted attachments.

contracts.name: UserIntent
contracts.canonical_encoding: RFC 8785 JSON
contracts.unknown_fields: Reject unknown desired effects, budgets, or signer rules.
contracts.privacy: May contain private preferences; only the minimum signing display leaves the client.

contracts.name: ChainStateEvidence
contracts.canonical_encoding: RFC 8785 JSON with canonical ledger bytes as base64url
contracts.unknown_fields: Reject unknown consensus or state fields.
contracts.privacy: Public chain data plus provider provenance; access patterns can be sensitive.

contracts.name: TransactionPlan
contracts.canonical_encoding: RFC 8785 JSON plus canonical target-ledger transaction bytes
contracts.unknown_fields: Reject unknown transaction effects or proof requirements.
contracts.privacy: Contains public effects and proof requirements; never contains raw witnesses.

contracts.name: ProofParameterSet
contracts.canonical_encoding: RFC 8785 JSON metadata plus externally stored parameter bytes
contracts.unknown_fields: Reject unknown proof systems, networks, or parameter roles.
contracts.privacy: Public cryptographic material and provenance.

contracts.name: ProofRequest
contracts.canonical_encoding: RFC 8785 JSON; private inputs remain in an isolated attachment
contracts.unknown_fields: Reject unknown prover permissions or witness destinations.
contracts.privacy: Private witnesses never enter the canonical request or an unapproved endpoint.

contracts.name: ProofReceipt
contracts.canonical_encoding: RFC 8785 JSON plus proof bytes by digest
contracts.unknown_fields: Reject unknown proof status or identity fields.
contracts.privacy: Public proof and measurements; private witness data is prohibited.

contracts.name: VerificationResult
contracts.canonical_encoding: RFC 8785 JSON with sorted reason codes
validation: status is verified, rejected, or unavailable
contracts.unknown_fields: Reject unknown status or mandatory check fields.
contracts.privacy: No witnesses; diagnostics use redacted identifiers.

contracts.name: SigningRequest
contracts.canonical_encoding: RFC 8785 JSON plus canonical ledger body bytes by digest
contracts.unknown_fields: Reject unknown effects or signer roles.
contracts.privacy: Contains only information approved for the signing display.

contracts.name: SignatureReceipt
contracts.canonical_encoding: RFC 8785 JSON with canonical signature bytes
contracts.unknown_fields: Reject unknown signature algorithms or signer roles.
contracts.privacy: Public signature evidence; wallet internals and private keys are prohibited.

contracts.name: SubmissionReceipt
contracts.canonical_encoding: RFC 8785 JSON
contracts.unknown_fields: Reject unknown submission status values.
contracts.privacy: Public chain identifiers; provider access metadata can be sensitive.

contracts.name: ConformanceResult
contracts.canonical_encoding: RFC 8785 JSON
contracts.unknown_fields: Reject unknown pass states or vector roles.
contracts.privacy: Public release evidence with host paths and secrets redacted.

contracts.name: EvidenceManifest
contracts.canonical_encoding: RFC 8785 JSON
contracts.unknown_fields: Reject unknown evidence status or artifact roles.
contracts.privacy: Public evidence index; raw private research or witness data remains in controlled storage.

contracts.name: RuntimeRequest
contracts.canonical_encoding: RFC 8785 JSON
contracts.unknown_fields: Reject unknown decision-bearing operations.
contracts.privacy: Requests minimize party and contract discovery data.

contracts.name: ExternalEvidence
contracts.canonical_encoding: RFC 8785 JSON with domain-separated signature payload
contracts.unknown_fields: Reject unknown evidence kinds or signature domains.
contracts.privacy: Values can be committed or selectively disclosed under the visibility manifest.
